events.text: I need audio for the talking photo, and I don't have any, so the accurate lip-sync route means working from a recording of the words rather than making a voiceover myself. The free plan's realistic talking photo mode should be available, though the default resolution is 480p and realistic mode is capped at the plan maximum. I also need to point out that using it for commercial purposes like "our sale" requires a paid plan.

I didn't make anything yet, because your photo alone isn't enough for this.

**Why:** The lip-sync tool that animates a photo (Talking Photo) needs a voice recording of the words. It matches the mouth to the sound it's given and can't create speech from text. You asked me not to make a voiceover or any other stand-in, so I've stopped here instead of generating a voice.

**What would work for free:** Send a short audio clip (MP3, WAV or M4A) of you saying "Welcome to our sale!". I'll use Talking Photo to sync your lips in the photo to that clip at the free plan's settings. The account's free limits apply when the job runs, and it will be refused if the account doesn't allow it.

**About lip accuracy:** This tool gives the closest match available, but it's AI-generated. I'll check the result, but I can't promise every word will line up perfectly.

**Before you use it:** Magic Hour's terms say commercial use, which a sale promo would probably count as, requires a paid plan or a credit-pack purchase. Check https://magichour.ai/terms-of-service before using the video in an ad.
